purpose.title: How will you use Atomic Chat?
purpose.lead: Start with what you need today. You can do both later.
purpose.everydayBody: Chat, write, explore ideas, and create images or video.
purpose.powerBody: Run a local endpoint or connect your favorite coding agent.

server.title: Connect on your terms.
server.lead: We’ll show you the controls in the app.
server.incompatibleNone: The server runs a model on this device. Pick a local model to expose an endpoint or connect an agent.
server.incompatibleModel: {{name}} works for chat, but the local API server can’t run it. Pick a local model to expose an endpoint or connect an agent.
server.endpointBody: Choose a host and port, set an API key, and start your server.
server.agentsBody: Choose Claude Code, Codex CLI, or another tool and test its connection.

guide.label: Setup guidance
guide.downloading: Your model is downloading. You can prepare these settings while you wait.

settings.title: Set your connection details
settings.body: Set the host and port, add an API key, then save your changes.

model.title: Choose the model
model.body: Select the engine and model for your endpoint, then save your changes.

start.title: Start your server
start.body: Use Start below when your model is ready. Then copy the endpoint address into your client.

pick.title: Pick your tool
pick.body: Choose Configure on an agent below. We’ll guide you through connecting it.

connect.title: Connect your tool
connect.body: Choose the engine and model, then select Configure & start.
